info.name: Calendar Live API
Calendar Events
Searches for a single event by its unique identifier.

params.name: id
params.description: Number that uniquely identifies the event.

params.name: filter[event_language]
params.description: Translate descriptions to this language if translation is available, otherwise show English version

params.name: options[show_ecoinfo]
params.description: Include ecoinfo as part of the event result.

items.docs: Searches for a single event by its unique identifier.

info.name: Searches for specific events based on the given filter.

params.name: filter[has_key_events_only]
params.description: Include only macroeconomic events that Dow Jones editors have classified as having a market impact. This categorization is based on news judgement and is updated on news merit.

params.name: filter[has_confirmed_events_only]
params.description: Include only events whose date and time have been confirmed.

params.name: filter[time_specified]
params.description: Filter events based on time specified

params.name: filter[country]
params.description: ORed list of countries associated with the event (e.g. BH-Bahrain, AZ-Azerbaijan). These are countries related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the event. Use ISO codes and separate them with new lines when providing multiple codes.

params.name: filter[region]
params.description: ORed list of regions associated with the event (e.g. EMEM, EU, G10). These are regions related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the event. Use new lines when providing multiple region codes.

params.name: filter[event_code]
params.description: Event type: ICC-Corporate events, IEP-Economic and Political events, IDC-Treasury Auctions.

params.name: filter[series_code]
params.description: ORed list of event series codes (e.g. TrdBal-Trade Balance, ImptPx-Import Prices). Series codes enable searching for historical and upcoming repeatable events. Use new lines when providing multiple series codes.

params.name: filter[event_class]
params.description: Single classification of the event (e.g. IEP_STAT-Statistics and Economic Indicators, ICC_ANL-Earnings/Analysts Calls and GMs).

params.name: filter[start_date]
params.description: Earliest date and time of interest, yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'.

params.name: filter[end_date]
params.description: Latest date and time of interest, yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'.

params.name: filter[ticker]
params.description: ORed list of Newswires codes. Use new lines when providing multiple ticker codes.

params.name: filter[isin]
params.description: ORed list of ISINs. Use new lines when providing multiple isin codes.

params.name: filter[event_language]
params.description: Translate descriptions to this language if translation is available; otherwise, show English version.

params.name: options[show_ecoinfo]
params.description: Include ecoinfo as part of the events results.

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of results for a single request, max size 1000.

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: Paging offset, the event ID given serves as a reference point to request additional events (beyond what was returned according to the limit value). The response does not include the reference ID. To page backward to get older events, make the event number negative.

info.name: IPO Calendar Events
Searches for IPO events given a comma-separated list of unique identifiers.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of unique identifiers corresponding to the IPO events you want to retrieve.

items.docs: Searches for IPO events given a comma-separated list of unique identifiers.

info.name: Searches for specific IPO events based on the given filter.

params.name: filter[date_type]
params.description: Date type.

params.name: filter[start_date]
params.description: Earliest date and time of interest, yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'.

params.name: filter[end_date]
params.description: Latest date and time of interest, yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'.

params.name: filter[issuer_country]
params.description: ORed list of issuer countries associated with the IPO event (e.g. BH-Bahrain, AZ-Azerbaijan). These are countries related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the  IPO event. Use ISO codes and separate them with new lines when providing multiple codes.

params.name: filter[exchange_country]
params.description: ORed list of exchange countries associated with the IPO event (e.g. BH-Bahrain, AZ-Azerbaijan). These are countries related to the entity that provides data or sponsorship for the  IPO event. Use ISO codes and separate them with new lines when providing multiple codes.

params.name: filter[exchange]
params.description: ORed list of exchange associated with the IPO event (e.g. BH-Bahrain, AZ-Azerbaijan). Use ISO codes (MIC) and separate them with new lines when providing multiple codes.

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: Maximum number of results for a single request, max size 1000.

params.name: page[offset]
params.description: Paging offset, the IPO event ID given serves as a reference point to request additional events (beyond what was returned according to the limit value). The response does not include the reference ID. To page backward to get older events, make the event number negative.
